description: Curriculum topic bank for listening content generation, aligned with WIDA ELP levels 1–6. Topics increase in cognitive and linguistic complexity as students progress. Each level maps to a proficiency band and provides topic categories, specific topics, discourse types, and vocabulary tiers appropriate for that level.

questionTypes.main_idea: Identify the central message or purpose of a listening passage
questionTypes.detail: Recall a specific fact or piece of information stated explicitly
questionTypes.inference: Draw a conclusion not directly stated in the audio
questionTypes.sequence: Identify or reconstruct the order of events or steps
questionTypes.vocabulary_in_context: Determine the meaning of a word or phrase as used in the passage
questionTypes.speaker_purpose: Identify why the speaker said something or what they were trying to do
questionTypes.tone_attitude: Recognize the speaker's feelings, tone, or point of view
questionTypes.cause_effect: Identify what caused an event or what resulted from it
questionTypes.compare_contrast: Note how two ideas, people, or things are alike or different
questionTypes.summarize: Condense the key points of a passage into a brief statement

levels.complexityNote: Grade 6–8 middle school content delivered in 1–2 short oral statements. Single nouns and action verbs, highly repetitive patterns, visual support assumed. Students identify or point to familiar school-subject objects, places, and people.
levels.vocabularyTier: Tier 1 — high-frequency concrete nouns and verbs tied to middle school subjects (e.g. 'cell', 'map', 'vote', 'orbit')
